title: AI Quick Start: Build Orchard Core Sites With a Coding Agent | Orchard Core
description:
An AI assistant can scaffold Orchard Core modules, write recipes, generate content type migrations and explain how a feature works, but only when its answers reflect how Orchard Core actually works.

The Orchard Core MCP server gives an assistant tool-based access to the Orchard Core documentation, and AI Skills add repeatable workflows. This video connects GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor and other clients to the server at https://ai.orchardcore.net/mcp, then shows what to ask for.

In this video:
• Why an assistant needs the Orchard Core documentation
• What the Orchard Core MCP server is, and its address
• Connect GitHub Copilot: the CLI, github.com and Visual Studio Code
• Connect Claude Code and Claude Desktop
• Connect Cursor and other clients
• AI Skills, a community project
• What to ask for, and how to give the assistant context
• Next steps in the documentation
